name: WF5 - Daily Buy-Back Report
note: Hardened 2026-09-01: no Supabase service-role. Daily 08:00 Asia/Colombo (or POST /webhook/nexus/report) → POST {NEXUS_APP_URL}/api/internal/n8n/daily-report. Optional body.team_id scopes to one tenant. App computes stats, summarizes, and upserts daily_reports.

parameters.content:
## Nexus OS — WF5 Daily Buy-Back Report

POST `/api/internal/n8n/daily-report` with bootstrap token.
The app builds and upserts today's report per tenant — no Supabase REST from n8n.

Optional webhook body `{ team_id }` to run a single tenant.

**Required n8n Variables:** `NEXUS_APP_URL`, `N8N_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN` (or `N8N_INGEST_TOKEN`). Webhook also needs `N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`.

**Do NOT** use Supabase service-role credentials in this workflow.
